title.en: Chapter 10 — A Hat and a Goose

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: بعد عيد الميلاد، جاب لنا الشرطي قبعة قديمة ووزة.
sentences.en: After Christmas, the constable brought us an old hat and a goose.

sentences.ar: قال: واحد وقعوا منه بخناقة وهرب.
sentences.en: He said: a man dropped them in a scuffle and ran off.

sentences.ar: هولمز قلب القبعة وقال: صاحبها كان غني وصار فقير.
sentences.en: Holmes turned the hat over and said: its owner was rich and became poor.
And he is clever, and his wife has stopped loving him.
I asked him: and where does the wife come from?

sentences.ar: قال: القبعة ما انكنست من أسابيع.
sentences.en: He said: the hat has not been brushed in weeks.

sentences.ar: المرا اللي بتحب زوجها ما بتتركه يطلع هيك.
sentences.en: A woman who loves her husband does not let him go out like that.
